# Marquee

AI-driven Scouting and Recruitment Decision-support Platform for Professional Football Clubs

Business Software

Private

## Company Overview

### Snapshot

Founded in December 2025 by Dean Bracha, Dror Rosenfeld, Jonathan Hazut, and Tal Darchi, Marquee operates with 1–10 employees. The company has raised $6.5M across two funding rounds from nine investors. In July 2026, Marquee secured its latest funding round to scale its AI decision layer across global sports.

### Business overview

Marquee develops an AI-driven scouting and recruitment decision-support platform for professional football clubs. The company's core technology integrates data from various sources, including tracking feeds, match data, video, and scouting notes, and filters it through each club’s specific philosophy to provide a 360-degree view of players with contextualized insights. Marquee enables clubs to use natural language queries to receive structured, actionable answers, streamlining the process of comparing targets, prioritizing recruitment options, and supporting board-level decisions. It serves the sports industry, specifically professional football, by reducing manual work and structuring fragmented data for modern football operations.

### Strategic signal

In July 2026, Marquee raised $6.5 million to scale its AI decision layer across global sports. This significant funding indicates strong investor confidence in Marquee's potential to revolutionize player scouting and recruitment through advanced AI. The investment signals a strategic move to expand its market reach and further develop its technology, positioning Marquee as a key innovator in sports tech.

## Marquee — full profile (machine-readable)

Marquee connects data from multiple sources such as tracking feeds, match data, video, and scouting notes, then filters it through each club’s own philosophy to give a 360° view of a player with contextualized insights. Clubs use it to ask questions in natural language and get structured, actionable answers instead of working in spreadsheets, helping scouts, sporting directors, and analysts compare targets, prioritize recruitment options, and support board-level decisions more efficiently. Testimonials from leaders in clubs such as FC Barcelona, Hapoel Tel Aviv, Ajax, and Chicago Fire highlight Marquee’s focus on reducing manual work, structuring fragmented data, and becoming a central system for modern football operations and decision-making.
